chapter.li: LEChapter1 Verse1 Jude (the servant of God, called of Jesus Christ, and brother of James), to them who are sanctified of the Father and preserved in Jesus Christ: VerseEnd Verse2 Mercy unto you, and peace, and love be multiplied. VerseEnd

Verse3 Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you and exhort you that you should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints; VerseEnd Verse4 for there are certain men crept in unawares who were before of old ordained to this condemnation — ungodly men turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God and our Lord Jesus Christ. VerseEnd Verse5 I will therefore put you in remembrance (though you once knew this) how the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not. VerseEnd Verse6 And the angels who kept not their first estate but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day. VerseEnd Verse7 Even as Sodom, and Gomorrah, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of Eternal fire, VerseEnd Verse8 likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities. VerseEnd Verse9 Yet Michael the Archangel, when contending with the Devil — he disputed about the body of Moses — dared not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke you. VerseEnd Verse10 But these speak evil of those things which they know not, but what they know naturally as brute beasts; in those things, they corrupt themselves. VerseEnd Verse11 Woe unto them, for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and shall perish in the rebellion of Korah. VerseEnd

Verse12 These are spots in your feasts of charity when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear; clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; autumnal trees, barren of fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots; VerseEnd Verse13 raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever. VerseEnd Verse14 And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord comes with ten thousands of his saints VerseEnd Verse15 to execute judgment upon all, and to convict all who are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches, which ungodly sinners have spoken against him. VerseEnd

Verse16 These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts, and their mouth speaks great inflated words, having countenances in awe because of advantage. VerseEnd Verse17 But beloved, remember the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ, VerseEnd Verse18 how they told you there should be mockers in the last time who should walk after their own ungodly lusts. VerseEnd Verse19 These are they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the spirit. VerseEnd Verse20 But you, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the holy ghost, VerseEnd Verse21 keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life. VerseEnd Verse22 And of some have compassion, making a difference. VerseEnd Verse23 And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire, hating even the garment spotted by the flesh. VerseEnd

Verse24 Now unto him who is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy, VerseEnd Verse25 to the only wise God, our Savior, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen. VerseEnd
